title: Default sort is Customer name ascending case-insensitive; clicking a header replaces it
custom_preconds:
1. No saved view exists (first visit or cleared storage).
2. Customer names with mixed upper/lower-case first letters exist in the view (seed ZZAUTOTEST names like "acme test" and "Best Test").
custom_steps:
1. Open the report and read the customer order.
2. Click the Subtotal header and read the order again.
custom_expected:
1. On first load, rows are ordered by Customer name, ascending, case-insensitive (a lower-case "acme" sorts by letter, not after all capitals).
2. Clicking a column header replaces the default with that column's sort.
